def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    separators = []

    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            color = grid[r][0]
            outside = [grid[rr][c] for rr in range(h) if rr != r for c in range(w)]
            if color not in outside:
                separators.append(("row", r))
    for c in range(w):

            outside = [grid[r][cc] for r in range(h) for cc in range(w) if cc != c]
            if color not in outside:
                separators.append(("col", c))

    if not separators:
        raise ValueError("No unique monochrome separator found")
    orient, sep = separators[0]
    if orient == "row":
        a, b = grid[:sep], grid[sep + 1:]
        n = min(len(a), len(b))
        a, b = a[:n], b[:n]
        rows, cols = n, w
    else:
        a = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
        b = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
        cols = min(len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
